models_evaluated: knowledge graph-enhanced LLM (KG-LLM) with retrieval-augmented generation

links.outcome: Accuracy, completeness, and unsupported factual content of KG-grounded LLM versus standalone LLM answers
links.effect: KG-LLM accuracy mean 3.05 vs 2.02 (Holm-adjusted P<.001); completeness 3.11 vs 2.42 (adjusted P=.002); unsupported content 0/78 (0%) vs 11/78 (14.1%) standalone (adjusted P=.002).
links.quote: KG-LLM achieved higher accuracy and completeness and less unsupported factual content on standardized tasks than the standalone LLM.

links.effect: Accuracy mean 3.05 vs 2.02, Holm-adjusted P<.001; completeness mean 3.11 vs 2.42, adjusted P=.002.
links.quote: Across 80 paired questions, KG-LLM achieved higher accuracy scores than the standalone LLM (mean 3.05, SD 1.88 vs mean 2.02, SD 1.54; Holm-adjusted P<.001) and higher completeness scores (mean 3.11, SD 1.84 vs mean 2.42, SD 1.62; adjusted P=.002).

links.effect: 4 of 5 physicians (80%) located both original publication and corresponding evidence.
links.quote: Of 5 physicians, 4 (80%) reported locating both the original publication and the corresponding evidence.
